title: Standing counterfactual grader for every closed order package (one decision = one trade): replay the actual price path and grade, in $ and % per account and in R, net of the full cost stack, the ACTUAL outcome against (a) the original entry brackets untouched, (b) alternative entry brackets (TP/SL grid around the declared ones), (c) no active management, (d) less / more active management (each in-trade action skipped, earlier, later; break-even/trail variants), (e) every reviewer or desk recommendation that was NOT applied, (f) a matched random intervention; book-level $ with the real sizer where BOOK-SIM-REAL-SIZER exists. Runs on every close, writes one graded record per package, feeds /performance-review and the AM graduation rule (RULE-AM-RISK-ADJUSTED-V1)
note: Basis: n=1 order package (ADA pkg-465a5d7d27644027), 3 account legs, window 2026-10-29 05:00Z..10:51Z. Lane archived; #21256 merged 2026-10-29 15:28Z (hourly per-close job). Post-exit horizon gap split to GRADER-POST-EXIT-HORIZON. [2026-11-05 BACKLOG-DRAIN-20261105] DONE: MEASURED: workflow counterfactual-grade-closed runs on schedule since 2026-10-29 (24 of 25 success); 49 records under comms/research/counterfactual_grades/ all graded_at >= 2026-10-29. NOT measured: the denominator (closed packages since 15:28Z 10-29) -- the closed-trades wire carries no package id, so coverage = 'every closed package' is an unverified claim; ask the grader's own coverage line if it needs proving.
